scope_and_status_excerpts.text: Do not demand a finished citation before exploring. A name, a news item, or a rough picture of nested geometry is a lead. Look it up, record what it points at, and keep the search moving. The Figueiredo prize was that kind of lead: the Russian-doll geometry and the award were real before the wording was a bibliography entry. Stopping until the citation was perfect would have dropped the clue. A reported result still names what was checked. Exploration does not wait for that sentence.

The question is a nested spherical geometry. Structure that one region does not resolve can still leave a local response, and the same relation can recur across scales. The candidate geometry that would enclose a region is a sphere. That is the picture under test. It is not an observation, and it is not a settled theory. The owning note keeps the method, the domain, and the evidence. [Scientific framing](instructions.md#scientific-framing-and-authority) remains the authority.

Do not start by defending LambdaCDM. Comparing or fitting it is not this task. A local equation is what an interior observer already uses. Computing only that side, and calling the unresolved exterior a separate substance, misses the question. Non-local here means the unresolved outside still acts on the local response. It does not mean an unbounded formal series.

A proved nested construction, not a metaphor, is the cosmohedron. Its faces are Matryoshkas: polygons sequentially wrapped into larger polygons ([2603.03425](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.03425)). The construction was proposed in [2412.19881](https://arxiv.org/abs/2412.19881) and extended to correlators in [2506.19907](https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.19907). Proof 6: Combined Significance — The Null Hypothesis Is Rejected

scope_and_status_excerpts.text: A prisoner in a sealed cell cannot see outside. The walls are absolute — no light, no signal, no information crosses them. To the prisoner, the cell is the entire universe. The question "what lies beyond these walls?" is not merely unanswerable — it is, in a precise physical sense, meaningless. The walls define the boundary of existence.

Now we connect the two horizons. If our universe is the interior of a black hole that formed in a parent universe, then the total entropy of the child universe cannot exceed the entropy of the parent black hole. This is the generalized second law of thermodynamics: total entropy never decreases.

At the Planck-scale bounce, semiclassical Hawking evaporation — a slow, low-energy process — does not have time to operate. The bounce is a "one-shot" channel. All parent entropy transfers to the child:
> *"The bounce does not destroy information. It recycles it. The prison becomes a nursery."*

> **Correction (the-action.md §4.2, §6):** the original text below identified the bounce density as the "Cartan density" \(10^{37}\) kg/m³ and the bounce as macroscopic (118 km). That branch assumes an equation of state that cannot hold at the density it predicts — at the bounce, the Fermi energy \(\hbar c n^{1/3} \sim 10^{18}\) eV exceeds the per-fermion mass budget by ~10¹⁹. It is retracted. The self-consistent ECKS bounce is near-Planck: \((0.7\text{–}15)\times10^{96}\) kg/m³, with a bounce r

Of the three, ECSK is the best fit for the nested model — on revised grounds (the-action.md §4.3): its self-consistent bounce converges with LQC on the near-Planck scale, making the bounce overdetermined; its torsion couples to the parent's spin, providing the mechanism for the preferred CMB axis, spin-mediated baryogenesis, and the fermion-only torsion filter that explains dark matter. The retired "macroscopic bounce" story (primordial black hole dark matter, star-sized transition) is supersede

Angular momentum is conserved. The parent's total angular momentum \(J_{\rm parent} = a_* GM^2/c\) — approximately \(1.9 \times 10^{87}\) kg·m²/s for \(a_* = 0.7\) — cannot vanish. It must be inherited by the child universe.

> *"The parent does not merely define the geometry of the child. It populates it — with dark matter, with dark energy, with the matter-antimatter imbalance, and with the constants of nature themselves."*

This makes a falsifiable prediction: the dark energy equation of state is \(w = -1\) **exactly**. \(\Lambda\) is a true cosmological constant — it does not evolve. DESI, Euclid, and the Roman Space Telescope will measure \(w\) to high precision within 5–10 years.
The Schwarzschild interior is a Kantowski–Sachs cosmology. This is differential geometry — not conjecture. Every black hole contains a contracting universe. **Status: Undeniable.**

The observable universe sits at the precise threshold of gravitational closure. \(C = 2GM_H/(c^2 R_H) = 1.0000000000\). This is required by flatness (\(\Omega_{\rm tot} = 1\)) — a direct consequence of the Friedmann equations. **Status: Observed. Not conjecture.**

The derived value matches the observed value to machine precision. The cosmological constant is the holographic shadow of the parent horizon. **Status: Derived from three laws of physics + one minimal assumption (saturation). Matches observation exactly.**

The entropy chain extends naturally to rotating (Kerr) black holes: \(\Lambda_{\rm Kerr} = \Lambda_{\rm Schwarzschild} / f(a_*)\). The spin parameter can be determined two independent ways — from \(\Lambda\) and from CMB anomalies — providing a consistency test. **Status: Derived. Testable.**

Four independent CMB analyses (WMAP, Planck 2013, 2015, 2018) identify four anomalous directions on the sky. These four vectors form an approximately orthogonal spin coordinate system — three vectors clustered along the parent's spin axis, one vector in the equatorial plane. The probability of this geometric configuration arising by chance: \(p \approx 0.001\) — **3.1σ**. No other cosmological model predicts this pattern. **Status: Observed. Unique discriminator for the nested model.**
> *"Infinity is not a size. It is a process. The prison does not trap you — it is the tunnel through which you escape into the next universe, and the next, and the next."*

A black hole is a prison. Its horizon is a one-way causal boundary — nothing escapes. The prisoner inside cannot see the parent universe from which the black hole formed. The parent cannot see the child universe forming within.

But the prison does not destroy. It transforms. The infalling matter and radiation are compressed to Planck-scale density, where quantum gravity replaces the classical singularity with a bounce. The contracting interior becomes an expanding universe. The parent's horizon entropy becomes the child's dark energy. The parent's supersymmetric particles become the child's dark matter. The parent's spin becomes the child's preferred axis, its matter-antimatter asymmetry, the rotation of its galaxies.

headings.text: How Do You Prove We Are In a Black Hole?
The 3 Things a Proof Would Require
1. A Falsifiable Prediction Unique to the Model
2. An Observable That Cannot Be Explained by the Interior Alone
3. A Signature at the Boundary or Origin
Test 1: Echoes from Nonsingular Black Hole Interiors
Test 2: Primordial Perturbation Spectrum from a Bounce
Test 3: Dark Energy as Horizon Memory
The Only Viable Path to Proof
What You Can Say Right Now

scope_and_status_excerpts.text: **You cannot — not with current data, and possibly not ever from interior-only measurements.**
This is the same reason a fish cannot prove it's in an ocean rather than a lake by only measuring the water around it. The local physics is the same.
### 2. An Observable That Cannot Be Explained by the Interior Alone

**Status:** Searches for echoes in LIGO-Virgo O3 data found **no significant evidence** [Abedi et al. 2020, Westerweck et al. 2021]. This doesn't falsify your model (echoes could be below current sensitivity), but it doesn't support it either.
**Status:** Planck 2018 gives \(n_s = 0.9649 \pm 0.0042\), consistent with standard slow-roll inflation. Some bounce models can reproduce this; others predict different tilts.

**What would prove it:** A specific bounce model that predicts a spectral tilt, running, or non-Gaussian signature that standard inflation cannot produce, confirmed by future CMB experiments (Simons Observatory, CMB-S4).
| Standard ΛCDM | Λ is a fundamental constant of nature (or a vacuum energy) — it does not evolve |

**Status:** Current data is consistent with constant Λ. If future surveys (DESI, Euclid, Roman) find Λ evolving with time, this would falsify the simplest version of your model but could support a more dynamic version.

**Status:** This is the most testable angle. You can simulate universes with varying constants and measure black-hole production. If our universe's constants sit near a local maximum of black-hole fertility, that's evidence for selection. Preliminary studies (Smolin, 1992; Harnik, Kribs & Perez, 2006) are suggestive but not conclusive.

**Status:** Planck 2018 gives Ω_K = 0.0007 ± 0.0019 — consistent with flat. However, some analyses of Planck data claim a slight preference for positive curvature (Di Valentino, Melchiorri & Silk, 2019 — disputed). If the universe turned out to be closed at a level consistent with black-hole interior topology, this would be a major clue.
C = 1               ← interesting, but not proof

> "The observable universe sits at \(C = 1\) — exactly the compactness of a black hole. This, combined with the fact that the cosmological constant can be expressed as a function of a parent horizon's entropy, suggests a model in which our universe is the interior of a black hole formed in a parent universe. The model makes several falsifiable predictions — nonsingular black-hole interiors, specific perturbation spectra, and Smolin-style natural selection — that distinguish it from standard ΛCDM
> "We cannot *prove* we're in a black hole today. But we can list exactly what would prove it, and several of those tests are within reach of current or near-future experiments."

\(C = 1\) is **necessary** for the universe to be a black hole, but it is **not sufficient** to prove it. The same equation falls out of standard flat ΛCDM. The proof requires a *differential* prediction — something your model predicts that the standard model does not. The five tests above are the path. Right now, none of them have confirmed your model over ΛCDM. But they could.

scope_and_status_excerpts.text: | Bell nonlocality | Loophole-free Bell tests exclude local-hidden-variable explanations. | A gradient medium cannot be an ordinary local three-dimensional fluid; its many-body state must be nonlocal/contextual and no-signalling. |

| Outside geometry replacing local phantom matter | An explicit RS2 effective-brane construction produces black-universe solutions with a positive-kinetic local scalar; the exotic null response is carried by the projected five-dimensional Weyl term. | Structural realization of \(\Gamma_{\mathrm{outside}}\); bulk completion and stability remain open. |

Primary anchors include the Tonomura single-electron experiment, PBR (`arXiv:1111.3328`), loophole-free Bell tests (`PRL 115, 250401` / `250402`), the BPS-Skyrme nuclear papers (`arXiv:1309.0820`, `arXiv:1312.2960`), the full gravitating BPS calculation (`arXiv:1503.03095`), the exact black-universe solution (`arXiv:gr-qc/0611022`), and Smolin’s cosmological natural-selection proposal (`arXiv:gr-qc/9404011`). The direct outside-geometry bridge is Bronnikov and Donskoy’s RS2 black-universe constr
not a claim that the generic Casimir, Wilson-line or gluing mechanisms are new.

Observed electron interference proves wave behavior and localized detections. It does not select a unique ontology in which a wavefunction is literally the material medium. QFT removes the classical particle/wave dichotomy by making a particle a quantum state of fields, but the wavefunction remains the amplitude assigned to a state, not an experimentally isolated second substance.

Exact black-universe solutions show that a black-hole exterior and expanding interior can belong to one regular four-geometry. They do not show that our observed universe is such an interior. A curvature singularity or an infinite limit alone also does not encode a child domain; the transition map and its conserved charges must be supplied.

And the outermost wall of the engine is the strongest one of all, because it is nothing. Every pocket is therefore a bounded, warm box. Order cannot win; chaos cannot win. The framework does not leave the question empty, however: the entropy-chain closure makes it a measurement.
